findings.highlight: I’m not obedient enough to follow her words
findings.evidenceJa: そんな言葉に頷けるほど物分りは良くはない
findings.governingReading: I am not accommodating/sensible enough simply to nod along with words like that
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inability to accept Rin’s advice as reasonable becomes a generic claim that he is disobedient.

findings.highlight: more than thatwhat can I do even if I go
findings.evidenceJa: 何より俺が駆けつけたところで、一体何ができるというのか
findings.governingReading: more than anything, what could I possibly do even if I rushed there?
findings.explanation: The missing separator visibly mangles the sentence, while “go” weakens Shirou’s imagined rush to the battle.

findings.highlight: from the top of the hillfrom the open area
findings.evidenceJa: 坂の上セイバーが弾き飛ばされた荒れ地から
findings.governingReading: from the wasteland atop the hill where Saber was flung
findings.explanation: A missing separator breaks the spatial description and “open area” weakens the established wasteland.
The cemetery’s breadth, relevant to the unseen continuing battle space, is omitted.
